sentence_stem: Although the project had limited funding,
correct_completion: the volunteers managed to plant over two hundred trees.
full_sentence: Although the project had limited funding, the volunteers managed to plant over two hundred trees.
acceptable_variants: the volunteers nevertheless planted over two hundred trees.
the volunteers still managed to finish the planting on schedule.

options.text: so the volunteers stopped working altogether.
options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result, which does not fit the contrast set up by 'although'.
This describes a state but does not complete the contrast expected after 'although'.

options.text: the volunteers managed to plant over two hundred trees.
they had already spent all their money.
options.why_wrong: This repeats the idea of limited funding instead of giving the contrasting outcome.

explanation: After 'although', the second clause must show a contrast with the first clause. Here the limited funding is contrasted with a successful achievement.
translation: Embora o projeto tivesse financiamento limitado, os voluntários conseguiram plantar mais de duzentas árvores.
